scenario.title: The Quarry Workshop · Gate trial
scenario.premise: An isolated third-job trial: the workshop supplies the village path makers.

stage.title: A trip to the quarry
stage.speaker: The path maker
stage.motivation: We need a sturdy carrier for coarse stones. Bring one to the quarry gate.
stage.travelText: The path makers stop at your workshop.

things.label: Hemp bundle
things.description: Fibres for making a coil of binding rope.

things.label: Twisting stick
things.description: A reusable tool for twisting fibres into rope.

things.label: Board kit
things.description: Prepared boards and their fasteners, enough for one closed crate.

things.label: Willow bundle
things.description: Flexible willow, enough for one open-weave basket.

locations.label: Quarry gate
locations.description: Bring a stone carrier here. The path makers take it on the collection trip and return it with gravel.

scenario.title: The Quarry Workshop · Gate trial
scenario.premise: An isolated third-job trial: the workshop supplies the village path makers.

stage.title: Hands free at the gate
stage.speaker: The parcel carriers
stage.motivation: The gate keeps dropping while we carry wide parcels through. Keep the opening clear. There is a ring above the raised gate and a free pulley hook.
stage.travelText: We bring our carriers, binding rope and gravel to the landing.

things.label: Willow bundle
things.description: Flexible willow, enough for one open-weave basket.

things.label: Rope coil
things.description: The shared coil you made supplies lengths for binding carriers and securing workshop fittings. The remaining coil stays available.

things.label: Perforated crate
things.description: The same crate, now pierced with small holes. Coarse gravel stays; fine sand falls through.

things.label: Sorted gravel
things.description: The coarse gravel remains after sifting. This shared pile supplies the path and small workshop uses; a portion can be used without exhausting it.

locations.label: Parcel gate
locations.description: A ring in the overhead beam can hold a tie to the raised gate. The other hook runs over a pulley. The walkway must remain clear for wide parcels.

engineEvents.message: Sorted gravel. Fine sand falls through the holes; coarse gravel remains. The sand falls away. The gravel is ready for the path.
